scope: Independent GitHub mirror + Rust documentation delivery (docs/scm-github-pages), attempt 2. Not phase 24/25; no phase review budget consumed. Gates publication of the documentation branch only.
acceptance_rule: Every category >=8 (satisfied: minimum 9), total >=46/50 (satisfied: 46/50) and no blocking findings (satisfied). Publication readiness is met; completed deployment is not asserted.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Two of the 31 derived guides are machine-generated (`tools/g25_report.py`, `tools/response_defaults.py`) and have `--check` gates bound only to the repository artifacts (contracts/compatibility/g25/comparison.json, contracts/response-defaults.json). Regenerating either guide passes every existing check while its site copy silently drifts. The new ownership policy in docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md:90-99 and DESIGN_SOURCE.json describes hand-edited guides ('update both in the same change') and does not cover regeneration. The site copy even carries the inherited comment 'Generated by python3 tools/g25_report.py; edit that source to update this report', which now points at a generator that cannot update it.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Mark generated sources in `derivedFrom` (or a `generatedBy` map) and either extend the two generators to emit the site page as well, or add a derivation check that compares the site copies to their guides and run it with the existing `--check` set.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The corrected gate paragraph links PHASES.md through a mutable branch ref, `https://github.com/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs/blob/docs/scm-github-pages/docs/PHASES.md`. It is the only branch-ref repository link on the site; everything else is pinned to commit efe9de04d9f60d48e6ba8528d1a07e86376d706d, including line 7 which pins the same file. docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md:22-24 anticipates reconciling the documentation branch after the source branches merge, which would break this link, and the mutable target weakens the 'current rubric' claim the sentence makes.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Either pin it to the same commit as line 7 (PHASES.md is unchanged at that commit and carries the current rubric), or point at `blob/main/docs/PHASES.md` once the rubric text is on mirrored main, and keep one convention per page.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The clean-directory evidence records three log digests, but only two logs are retained on disk (.local/github-pages/clean-ci.log for `npm ci`, clean-run.log for `npm run build`); no typecheck log exists anywhere under .local, so the recorded `3f2f8a90…` digest cannot be resolved to an artifact. All three logs also live only in the gitignored `.local/` tree, so none are published receipts, unlike the other evidence under docs/reviews/github-pages/. Separately, the retained logs show the install resolving through a local npm proxy (`verdaccio.verdaccio.svc.cluster.local:4873` user config, 1409 packages in 4-5s), so the clean install is not an exact reproduction of GitHub-runner resolution, although package-lock integrity hashes bound the contents.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Retain the three logs (or their relevant tails) under docs/reviews/github-pages/ next to checks.json so each digest resolves, and note the local-proxy registry in the check record.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The lockfile's root package entry still records only dependencies/devDependencies/engines and not the `overrides` block (qs, serialize-javascript, sockjs>uuid). The clean `npm ci` passes and the resolved tree satisfies the overrides, so this is cosmetic rather than a functional mismatch, but a future `npm install` may rewrite the root entry and make the diff look unrelated to the change that triggers it.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Regenerate the lockfile once with the current npm so the root entry records `overrides`, and keep the resolved versions unchanged in that commit.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Two pieces of prose now lag the delivered state. The build description still says 'The deployment workflow invokes `npm ci` and `npm run build`' although the workflow also runs `npm run typecheck` (covered later at :102-103), and the opening paragraph still frames the mirror as 'intended' and states that creating the workflow establishes nothing, while setup.json and mirrored-tags.json record an existing public repository, main at 0a213fe… and tags through 0.2.2 pushed with destination equality verified. The document is literally accurate (status is deferred to the receipts at :107-111, and :110 does assert the tags are mirrored) but mixes instruction and status in a way that invites misreading.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Add typecheck to the :35-38 sentence and give the opening section one status line pointing at setup.json/mirrored-tags.json for what is already configured, keeping the unpushed documentation branch and undeployed Pages explicitly open.

nonblocking_findings.finding: `onBrokenLinks` and `onBrokenMarkdownLinks` both throw, but `onBrokenAnchors` is unset and therefore defaults to 'warn' in Docusaurus 3, so the two cross-page anchor links (/core/validation#responses-without-inserted-defaults from core/response-defaults.md:22 and core/transport.md:154, /core/models#reserved-json-protocol-keys from developer/stability.md:78) are not build-enforced. Both targets exist today (docs-site/docs/core/models.md:66 verified in this review).
nonblocking_findings.fix: Set `onBrokenAnchors: 'throw'` so anchor drift fails the build like link drift already does.

nonblocking_findings.finding: 23 references to internal phase numbers ('Phase 7 also implemented the separately gated `connect_realtime` method', 'accepted in Phase 7', 'Phase 8 adds…') appear on public pages with no explanation of what a phase is. This is inherited verbatim from the authoritative repository guides and is consistent with the declared derivation rule, so it is a style property rather than an inaccuracy, but public readers have no context for the vocabulary.
nonblocking_findings.fix: Either add one sentence on the developer index explaining that phase numbers refer to the repository's internal implementation phases (linking PHASES.md), or drop the phase attributions when deriving pages, applying the same wording to the guides.

nonblocking_findings.finding: `derivedFrom` keys are relative to `docs-site/` while values are relative to the repository root, and both begin with `docs/` (for example `"docs/core/transport.md": "docs/FOUNDATION.md"`). GITHUB_MIRROR.md documents the key convention only.
nonblocking_findings.fix: State the value convention in the same sentence, or make the values explicit (`<repo>/docs/FOUNDATION.md`).

delivery_note: Both blocking findings and all nine nonblocking findings from attempt 1 are genuinely fixed, and each fix was checked against its primary source rather than accepted from the fix summary. The documentation scope is publication-ready: content is accurate and complete against CHANGELOG/Cargo/auth/PHASES, the gate description no longer misstates the project's own process, ownership and update procedure are explicit, the build is reproducible from a clean source-only tree with broken links fatal and TypeScript checked in CI, actions are pinned to dated exact patch tags, and the mirror/Pages receipts record what is actually configured. Readiness is not deployment: setup.json reports site_deployed false and pages.status null, the documentation branch is intentionally unpushed, and the workflow run plus the live https://cdot65.github.io/scm-sdk-rs/ URL remain to be observed and recorded after publication. The eight nonblocking findings here are maintenance hardening (generated-guide derivation check, one mutable branch-ref link, retained log receipts, lockfile overrides, two prose lags, anchor enforcement, inherited phase vocabulary) and none should delay the push.
